Best Italian, Sushi & Breakfast Restaurants in Destin FL — 2026

20 Restaurants Across 5 Categories — Ranked by a Local Condo Owner Who Actually Eats Here

Distances from Pelican Beach Resort · Hidden gems included · Updated March 2026

By Ozan CILI, owner · Destin Condo Getaways · Updated March 2026

Destin has a reputation built on seafood — and it deserves it. But the restaurants that actually surprise people are the ones nobody mentions. Genuine Sicilian Italian, fresh Gulf sushi, a breakfast spot that’s been packing locals in since 1978, a Greek restaurant that survives the off-season on merit alone. This guide covers everything beyond the harbor seafood trail.

BETTER THAN YOU’D EXPECT FOR A BEACH TOWN

1. Osaka Japanese Hibachi & Sushi Bar

BEST SUSHI  •  34745 EMERALD COAST PKWY  •  ~10 MIN  •  $$  •  4.2★ (2.8K reviews)

The most complete Japanese dining experience in Destin — hibachi entertainment and a massive sushi menu under one roof. Best for groups where half want rolls and half want a show.

Must order: Osaka Roll, Crunchy Gator Roll, traditional nigiri

theosakasteakhouse.com

2. Sushimoto ⭐ Hidden Gem

BEST AUTHENTIC SUSHI  •  MIRAMAR BEACH  •  ~12 MIN  •  $$  •  4.5★ (500 reviews)

Tucked away in Miramar Beach — small, chef-focused, serious about quality. Where sushi purists go. Sit at the bar and let the chef guide the order. The omakase is genuinely worth it.

Must order: Omakase, nigiri selection, chef’s daily special rolls

Insider tip: No reservations — it’s small, go early or expect a wait.

destinsushi.com

3. Jackacuda’s Seafood & Sushi

BEST FUSION  •  36120 EMERALD COAST PKWY  •  ~5 MIN  •  $$  •  4.5★ (2.6K reviews)

Gulf Coast seafood meets Japanese technique. Waterfront location with harbor views. Creative fusion rolls without being gimmicky. Solid local beer selection at the bar.

Must order: Shrimp Ramen Bowl, Gulf Coast Roll, specialty rolls

jackacudas.com

4. Thai Delights Restaurant

BEST THAI  •  821 HARBOR BLVD  •  ~5 MIN  •  $  •  4.3★ (462 reviews)

Casual Thai right on Harbor Blvd — locals’ go-to when they want something different from seafood. Vegetarian-friendly, kids’ menu, great value at $10–20 per person.

Must order: Pad Thai, green curry, spring rolls

WHY DESTIN SUSHI IS BETTER THAN YOU EXPECT

Being on the Gulf means the fish is genuinely fresh. Osaka for groups — let half the table do hibachi while the other half orders rolls. The Osaka Roll and Crunchy Gator Roll are signatures. Sushimoto for a real sushi experience — small, intimate, sit at the bar, order the Sushimoto Roll. Jackacuda’s on a weekday for the all-you-can-eat lunch buffet — one of the best deals on the harbor.

🍕 Best Italian restaurants in Destin Florida 4 restaurants ▼

LA DOLCE VITA ON THE EMERALD COAST

1. Mimmo’s Ristorante Italiano

BEST ITALIAN  •  979 US-98  •  ~10 MIN  •  $$$  •  4.5★ (3K reviews)

Destin’s gold standard for authentic Italian — homemade pasta, wood-fired Neapolitan pizza, family recipes consistent for over 20 years. Warm, unpretentious, always packed because the food earns it.

Must order: Homemade pasta (ask what’s fresh), wood-fired pizza, osso buco

Insider tip: Book 2–3 days ahead during peak season. This place fills up.

mimmos.com

2. Pazzo Italiano ⭐ Owner’s Pick

OWNER’S PICK  •  34904 EMERALD COAST PKWY  •  ~8 MIN  •  $$  •  4.6★ (2.2K reviews)

My personal favorite for Italian in Destin. A wood-fired oven imported from Naples, housemade pasta, family recipes perfected over 20+ years. The complimentary garlic bread with olive oil alone is worth the visit. Consistently excellent.

Must order: Wood-fired Margherita pizza, Penne al Vodka, Chicken Picante, house bread with garlic oil

Insider tip: Reservations strongly recommended in peak season. Ask for the back room for a quieter table.

pazzodestin.com

3. Nonna’s Ristorante

HARBOR ITALIAN  •  HARBORWALK VILLAGE  •  ~5 MIN  •  $$$  •  4.6★ (36 reviews)

Authentic Italian right on Destin Harbor overlooking the Gulf. Handmade pasta, wood-fired dishes, beautiful waterfront setting by Chef Tim Creehan. Newer spot — fewer reviews but the quality is real.

Must order: Housemade pasta, seafood risotto, tiramisu

Insider tip: Request a harbor-facing table — the view makes the meal.

nonnasristorante.com

5. Fat Clemenza’s

BEST PIZZA / BUDGET  •  MIRAMAR BEACH  •  ~8 MIN  •  $  •  4.4★ (1.5K reviews)

NY-style pizza done right — huge slices, generous toppings, calzones the size of a small child. Casual, fast, budget-friendly. Great for families with kids who have already had enough fine dining for one trip.

Must order: NY-style pizza by the slice, calzone, classic pasta

MIMMO’S VS PAZZO — WHICH ONE?

Mimmo’s is Sicilian family recipes from owner Mimmo La Innusa himself, who is often in the restaurant. Order the Lobster Pappardelle in vodka sauce and save room for the handmade cannoli. Reserve ahead — it fills up fast. Pazzo is more relaxed, slightly cheaper, Best in Destin award winner, wood-fired pizza worth ordering. The Pappardelle dello Chef with smoked Gouda and truffle oil is the sleeper hit. Fat Clemenza’s is neither — it’s a $10 pizza and a cold beer, and that’s exactly what it should be.

🍺 Best American & pub restaurants in Destin Florida 4 restaurants ▼

INSTITUTIONS WORTH KNOWING

1. Fudpucker’s Beachside Bar & Grill

BEST FOR FAMILIES  •  BEACHSIDE ON US-98  •  ~10 MIN  •  $$  •  4.7★ (33K reviews)

Destin’s most reviewed restaurant — 33,000 reviews strong. Massive beachside complex with live alligator shows, an arcade, full bar, and a menu broad enough to feed any crowd. Gator bites are a Florida rite of passage.

Must order: Gator bites, grouper sandwich, frozen drinks

Insider tip: Go for lunch to beat the dinner crowds and let the kids spend time at the gator park.

fudpucker.com

2. McGuire’s Irish Pub

BEST IRISH PUB  •  33 US-98  •  ~8 MIN  •  $$  •  4.7★ (23K reviews)

A legendary Destin institution. Dollar bills stapled to the ceiling, 28-day aged Prime steaks, live Irish music nightly from 9pm. A Destin bucket-list experience regardless of whether you’re into pubs.

Must order: 28-day aged Prime Steak, Senate Bean Soup (18 cents!), Irish Wake Cheesecake

Live music: Nightly from 9pm. Fun fact: Sign a dollar bill and put it on the wall — it’s a Destin tradition.

mcguiresirishpub.com

3. Harry T’s Lighthouse

HARBORWALK CASUAL  •  46 HARBOR BLVD  •  ~5 MIN  •  $$  •  4.3★ (2.5K reviews)

Casual waterfront dining at HarborWalk Village with mid-range pricing and great harbor views. Not fancy — good food, cold drinks, front-row seat to harbor action. Charter boats return 3–5pm daily.

Must order: Grouper sandwich, burgers, cold drinks on the deck

harrytslighthouse.com

4. The Harbor Tavern ⭐ Local Favorite

LOCAL FAVORITE  •  306 HARBOR BLVD  •  ~5 MIN  •  $  •  4.7★ (887 reviews)

Small, unpretentious, exactly the kind of spot tourists rarely find because it doesn’t try to be found. Casual harbor-side bar with a loyal local following — cold beer, solid burgers, genuine locals’ vibe.

Must order: Burgers, wings, cold draft beer

Insider tip: This is where you go when you want to feel like a local, not a tourist.

HOW TO DO McGUIRE’S RIGHT

McGuire’s is a legitimate institution — 4.7 stars from 23,000 reviews doesn’t happen by accident. Go for the Irish stew and hand-cut steaks, not the burger. Arrive before 6pm or expect a wait. Nightly Irish music starts at 9pm. Fudpucker’s is the family move — gator shows, arcade, no stress about kids. Harbor Tavern is the local’s bar: no attitude, cold beer, honest food, 4.7 stars from people who actually live here.

🍳 Best breakfast & brunch restaurants in Destin FL 3 restaurants ▼

START THE BEACH DAY RIGHT

1. Crackings

BEST BREAKFAST IN DESTIN  •  ~8 MIN  •  $  •  4.7★ (2K reviews)

The best breakfast in Destin, full stop. Locals and guests both swear by it — hearty portions, great coffee, friendly staff. Opens at 7 AM and gets busy fast.

Must order: Eggs Benedict, loaded skillets, fresh-squeezed juice

Insider tip: Arrive by 8 AM on weekends. By 9 AM there’s a wait.

crackingsfl.com

2. Ruby Slipper

BEST BRUNCH  •  NEW ORLEANS STYLE  •  ~10 MIN  •  $$  •  4.7★ (2.5K reviews)

New Orleans-style brunch on the Emerald Coast. Rotating Eggs Benedict variations, Bananas Foster French toast, and a Bloody Mary worth staying for. Expect a wait on weekends — it’s worth it.

Must order: Eggs Benedict daily special, Bananas Foster Pain Perdu, Bloody Mary

Insider tip: Put your name on the list before you sit — wait can be 45+ min on summer Sundays.

rubybrunch.com

3. Donut Hole Bakery & Café

DESTIN INSTITUTION  •  635 HARBOR BLVD  •  ~5 MIN  •  $  •  4.5★ (1.6K reviews)

A Destin staple since forever. Fresh donuts, key lime pie that people drive across the state for, full breakfast menu open from 6am to 10pm daily. The key lime pie alone is worth a stop.

Must order: Fresh donuts (go early for best selection), key lime pie, crab cake benedict

donutholerestaurant.com

BEAT THE BREAKFAST WAIT

Crackings and Ruby Slipper both have lines by 9am in peak season — arrive at 8am or earlier. Crackings is the local move: cheap, no-frills, best breakfast sandwich on the coast. Ruby Slipper is the brunch experience — Eggs Cochon, Bananas Foster French Toast, proper cocktails. Donut Hole has been feeding Destin since 1978 — open 24 hours. Order the grouper sandwich for breakfast if you want to eat like a local.

🌿 Hidden gem restaurants & local spots in Destin 3 restaurants ▼

INDEPENDENT SPOTS THAT SURVIVE ON LOCALS YEAR-ROUND

These aren’t tourist traps. They’re the independent places that have been here for years — the ones that stay open in the off-season because locals keep them going. That’s the real signal of a good restaurant in a beach town.

1. Red Onion Organic Restaurant

MEDITERRANEAN  •  529 HARBOR BLVD  •  ~5 MIN  •  $  •  4.5★ (600 reviews)

Family-owned hidden gem right on Harbor Blvd. Fresh organic Mediterranean — lamb chops, gyros, falafel, stuffed grape leaves. Casual, no tourist markup, loyal local following. One of those places where the exterior doesn’t hint at how good the food is inside.

Must order: Lamb chops, gyros, stuffed grape leaves, babagannouj

2. Aegean Greek Restaurant

GREEK  •  MIRAMAR BEACH  •  ~12 MIN  •  $$  •  4.4★ (407 reviews)  •  FAMILY-OWNED SINCE 2007

Family-owned Greek restaurant in Miramar Beach since 2007. One of the very few authentic Greek spots on the Emerald Coast. Full breakfast menu daily until 2pm — the gyro eggs Benedict is a local favorite.

Must order: Gyros, Greek salad, spanakopita, gyro eggs Benedict at brunch

aegeanfl.com

3. Capriccio Café

ITALIAN CAFÉ  •  810 HARBOR BLVD  •  ~5 MIN  •  $  •  4.8★ (1K reviews)

Snug Italian café with imported coffee and inventive café fare. Stylish, pared-down interior with European sensibility. One of those spots locals quietly love and tourists rarely find. Perfect for a morning espresso or a light lunch.

Must order: Espresso, Italian pastries, light lunch plates

THE PLACES TOURISTS WALK PAST

These three survive the off-season because locals keep coming back. Red Onion Organic — Mediterranean, fresh, cheap, 5 minutes from Pelican Beach. The hummus plate and falafel wrap are better than anything in that price range on the harbor. Aegean Greek — family-owned, generous portions, moussaka that tastes homemade. Capriccio Café — 4.8 stars, European café vibe, breakfast and lunch only. The kind of place you go back to every morning once you find it.

Practical tips for dining in Destin

Reservations: Mimmo’s needs reservations in peak season — book 2–3 days ahead via Resy. Pazzo, McGuire’s, and Fudpucker’s can handle walk-ins but get busy after 6pm on weekends.

Breakfast timing: Arrive before 8:30am at Crackings and Ruby Slipper or expect a wait. Donut Hole is 24 hours — no wait issues.

Budget: Sushi runs $15–25/person. Italian $25–40. McGuire’s and Fudpucker’s are $20–35. Hidden gems — Red Onion, Aegean, Capriccio — are all under $20/person and genuinely good.

From Pelican Beach Resort: Osaka, Mimmo’s, and Fudpucker’s are 10 minutes east. Fat Clemenza’s and Sushimoto are 12 minutes. Red Onion is 5 minutes on US-98. McGuire’s is 8 minutes west.

Frequently asked questions

What is the best sushi restaurant in Destin?

Osaka Japanese for groups — hibachi entertainment plus an extensive sushi menu. Sushimoto in Miramar Beach for a more intimate, authentic experience. Both use fresh Gulf-caught fish and are within 12 minutes of Pelican Beach Resort.

What is the best Italian restaurant in Destin?

Mimmo’s Ristorante for a genuine Sicilian experience — owner Mimmo is often in the restaurant, recipes are family handed-down, and the Lobster Pappardelle is exceptional. Pazzo Italiano is the more casual, slightly cheaper alternative with award-winning pasta and wood-fired pizza.

Where do locals eat breakfast in Destin?

Crackings for cheap, no-frills, genuinely good breakfast. Arrive before 8:30am or expect a wait. Donut Hole on US-98 has been a local institution since 1978 and is open 24 hours. Ruby Slipper is the brunch splurge — worth it for Eggs Cochon and Bananas Foster French Toast.

What is the best family restaurant in Destin?

Fudpucker’s — gator shows, arcade, food for all ages, and no stress. McGuire’s Irish Pub is also family-friendly and has the best atmosphere on a non-beach night in Destin.

Where do locals eat in Destin (hidden gems)?

Red Onion Organic for Mediterranean, Aegean Greek Restaurant in Miramar Beach, and Capriccio Café for European breakfast and lunch. All three are independent, all three survive the off-season on local regulars, and none of them need a reservation.

Is there good non-seafood food in Destin?

Much more than people expect. Mimmo’s and Pazzo for Italian, McGuire’s for steaks and Irish food, Osaka and Sushimoto for sushi, Red Onion and Aegean for Mediterranean. Destin’s dining scene goes well beyond the harbor seafood trail.
